title: 孩子做坏事，多半是因为没学过做好事
ref: On Education (1977, Progress Publishers), Part VI 'Morals and Convictions / Devotion to an Ideal Is Impossible Unless Man Feels a Deep Need for His Fellows', p. 300 (local ocr line 1207)
cn: 苏霍姆林斯基提醒：学生做出不良行为，往往不是有人教他作恶，而是成人从未认真教过他如何行善。道德教育应当把功夫下在“教善”上，而不是等坏事出现后再去追责和纠正。
excerpt: A schoolchild does not always do bad things because he has been taught to, but more often than not because he has not been taught to do good things.
excerpts: A schoolchild does not always do bad things because he has been taught to, but more often than not because he has not been taught to do good things.
